# OMP Strata

> Profile, lifecycle tool and acceptance evidence for running the stock Oh My Pi (OMP) coding agent against
> a stock, local Strata inference server on one Windows 11 + RTX host. It forks neither project and adds no
> proxy: every download is pinned by URL, size and SHA-256; stock `setup.py` runs unmodified from verified
> local inputs; Strata binds to loopback behind an API key; stock OMP runs in an isolated profile with every
> model role on the local server and no cloud fallback. Python standard library only. Qualified and current (2026-11-06; RTX 5090 131K alternative 2026-11-03):
> stock Strata v0.2.11 (engine 0.1.57) + stock OMP 18.16.0 across the RTX PRO 6000, the RTX 5090 262K default, the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 pair and the Mac Studio route (with the RTX 5090 131K alternative staying on stock Strata v0.2.10, engine 0.1.56, + stock OMP 18.16.0): on the
> RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 pair in `rtx3090-win-a` (Qwen3.8-Flash-Next IQ3_S at the trained 262,144-token context, stock
> roles `--gpu-roles 0=main,1=helper` putting the RTX 4090 as Main staged last, manual layer split 24 `--layer-split 24`,
> stage dense-weight trim `--trim-stage-weights` (`strata.trim_stage_weights: true`), stock DFlash2 drafting alone
> via `strata.drafting: "dflash2"` (`--draft dflash2 --draft-model <root>\data\dflash2\qwen3.8-flash-next-dflash2.q4_0-selq4.pack --draft-fallback none --draft-conf 0.35 --draft-vocab <root>\data\dflash2\draft_vocab.bin`,
> packed offline during `install` by stock `tools/dflash2_pack.py` from pinned `incoai/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-DFlash2` files
> with `STRATA_NO_ACQUIRE=1`), dropping `--pipeline-windows 2` and sizing the expert caches at 19.41 GiB on the RTX 3090
> and 17.90 GiB on the RTX 4090 on engine 0.1.57 vs 19.41 / 18.31 GiB on the v0.2.10 `df2` rollback and 19.14 / 17.75 GiB on the v0.2.10
> `pw2` (`--pipeline-windows 2`) `env86g` multi-token prediction (MTP) alternative, with G17's near-limit task wall at
> 61.1 s vs 59.0 s on v0.2.10 `df2`, no batch slots, display on the RTX 4090, `strata.ple_io: "direct"` pinning stock
> `--ple-io direct` to keep the 26.8 GiB per-layer embedding (PLE) table on direct SSD reads, preserving the engine's
> 8,192 MiB automatic conversation cache and 28.70 GiB G10 Windows commit headroom of a 135.69 GiB limit with 66.35 GiB
> available RAM, and `strata.engine_env` pinning the engine's `sm_86` default table `sm86_table` and stock `gdn_stack`,
> which in three paired cold starts against its v0.2.10 `df2` predecessor passed `w1` throughput at 1.008, `w3` at 0.999,
> TTFT at ~1.0, TPOT at 0.98-0.99, decode at 0.966-1.022 and prefill at 0.988-1.062 while missing 4 of 88 checks on
> burstiness only (`w1` longest gap p50/p95/max 1.125-1.126, depth-0 p95 inter-event gap 1.096), and passed all 14
> measured gates in the 2026-11-06 requalification chain at `772a418` (`ba574d5`) and complete G13 rerun at `611c342`
> (`3144675`) with 40.5-40.8 s restart readiness, G24 15/18, pilot 5/6 and batch wall 896 s after the owner overrode
> those burstiness misses (`"Override: run the main chain"`);
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-df2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86g-parking-strata0.2.11-omp18.16.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-df2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86g-parking-strata0.2.11-omp18.16.0/qualification.json);
> rolling back to the v0.2.10 `df2` DFlash2 profile
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-df2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86g-parking-strata0.2.10-omp18.16.0`
> with G10 27.51 GiB commit headroom of 135.69 GiB and 65.65 GiB available RAM, G16/G20/G21 43.1 / 43.2 / 43.4 s, G17
> near-limit task 59.0 s, G24 17/18, pilot 5/6, batch wall 916 s, while the v0.2.10 `pw2` `env86g` MTP profile
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86g-parking-strata0.2.10-omp18.16.0`
> remains qualified as an older alternative and the v0.2.9 `env86g` profile
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-env86g-parking-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0`
> and v0.2.9 base profile
> `win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-262k-pw2-disp4090-roles-split24-trimweights-pledirect-parking-strata0.2.9-omp18.15.0` stay
> earlier qualified history; three v0.2.8/v0.2.9 pair roots were pruned on 2026-11-06 with the owner's approval),
> on an RTX PRO 6000 (`rtxpro6000-win-a`) at the trained 262,144-token context with four batch slots, per-slot stock
> DFlash2 drafters via `strata.drafting: "dflash2"` (one 85 MiB slot drafter per slot under engine 0.1.57's
> `STRATA_BATCH_DF2`, 70.22 GiB free at start, `--spec 6`, no `--batch-mtp`; packed offline from pinned

> 78 GiB available-RAM start floor), stock `serve/server.py`'s Linux-only nine-switch parallel-slot stack and
> two-switch GDN tensor-core prompt stack in `strata.engine_env` (cold-start A/B against the v0.2.11 batch-MTP profile:
> single-request decode +20-26% at depth 0 1.201, 8K 1.258, 32K 1.203, 100K 1.142 and warm 32K 1.216, meeting the
> owner's +3% bar, with TTFT ~1.0, while missing 35 of 100 checks on concurrent short-request throughput/latency at

> and output-burst spacing at longest gap +12% and p95 inter-event gap +7-12%, overridden by the owner on 2026-11-06 as
> `"Override: qualify DFlash2 as PRO current"`), the engine's 8,192 MiB conversation parking (32 parks in G19) and bare
> `--prefill auto` (engine 0.1.57's 32,768-token ceiling), with 31.0-35.7 s restart readiness in G16/G20/G21, complete
> G15 rerun kill recall 29.2-29.3 s at `b812df9` (after the initial G15's first post-kill recall wrote the interrupted
> 11,178-token essay), and 83.55 GiB G10 Windows commit headroom of a 219.70 GiB limit with 127.14 GiB available RAM and
> 73,496 MiB GPU memory
> (`win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-df2-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-parking-strata0.2.11-omp18.16.0`;
> [ledger](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-df2-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-parking-strata0.2.11-omp18.16.0/qualification.json);
> rolling back to the v0.2.11 batch-MTP profile

> all three hosts (whose host integration roots were removed on 2026-10-28), the PRO and RTX 5090 v0.1.44.1 (including
> 262K), v0.1.43.1 and v0.1.43 profiles, the pair's v0.1.43.1 and v0.1.43 profiles, and each host's v0.1.42 + OMP 18.8.9
> profiles stay earlier qualified history. All earlier failed gates and passing reruns remain published.
> The pair's [earlier qualified 131K profile](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-131k-pw2-disp4090-strata0.1.42-omp18.8.9/qualification.json)
> keeps the display on the RTX 4090; its
> [earlier predecessor](https://github.com/alphastorm/omp-strata/blob/main/releases/win11-rtx3090-rtx4090-iq3s-131k-pw2-strata0.1.42-omp18.8.9/qualification.json)
> requires moving the display back to the RTX 3090. Single-card RTX 3090 profiles are not rollbacks
> while both cards are installed: they name GPU 0, now the RTX 4090. Earlier qualified history: on the RTX PRO 6000, stock Strata v0.1.41 + stock OMP
> 18.8.6 with the same choices at 262,144 tokens, then at 131,072 tokens, then the same choices on v0.1.40.3 + OMP
> 18.8.4, then OMP 18.8.3, then v0.1.40.2 + 18.8.0 without them; on the RTX 5090, v0.1.41 + OMP 18.8.6, then
> v0.1.40.3 + OMP 18.8.4, then stock Strata v0.1.34 + stock OMP 18.4.10, which also stays qualified on the
> single-card RTX 3090 and RTX 4090. Community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by the
> Oh My Pi maintainers, the Strata maintainer, Qwen or NVIDIA.

## Install

- From a checkout, with the current candidate profile: `validate` → `fetch` → `install` → `keygen` →
  `start` → `launch-omp` → `stop` (`py -3 scripts\omp_strata.py <command> --profile <profile> --root <root>`).
- One integration root per candidate; nothing is written to the user's normal OMP configuration or to
  `%APPDATA%\Strata`.

## Boundaries

- Supported: the qualified profiles under `profiles/` (Windows 11, a single NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000, RTX 5090, RTX 3090
  or RTX 4090, or the RTX 4090 + RTX 3090 layer-split pair; every other profile is a draft or a rollback installation),
  text only, single user, loopback only.
- Remote use: the Mac Studio's current qualified route,
  `client-rtxpro6000-262k-df2-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.11-omp18.16.0`, runs stock OMP 18.16.0 through an
  SSH local forward to `win11-rtxpro6000-iq3s-262k-slots4-df2-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-parking-strata0.2.11-omp18.16.0`,
  the PRO's current v0.2.11 262K `df2` DFlash2 profile (G23 pass on 2026-11-06 at `b812df9`: missing key refused before
  launch, wrong key 401, health RTT 6.0-10.1 ms and stream TTFT 0.270 s; tunnel drop failed the turn in flight with the
  prior transcript preserved, nonce recall passed after tunnel reopen 1.83 s, client restart 1.11 s and verified server
  restart 2.34 s, and a one-turn `launch-omp` smoke answered `ROUTE OK` with owned stop).
  Its qualified rollback, `client-rtxpro6000-262k-batchmtp-pledirect-kvvram-envpg-strata0.2.11-omp18.16.0`, reaches the
  PRO's v0.2.11 262K `batchmtp` rollback (G23 pass on 2026-11-06 at `9c6318b`: missing key refused before launch, wrong
  key 401, health RTT 5.3-6.5 ms and stream TTFT 0.174 s; tunnel drop failed the turn in flight with the prior
  transcript preserved, nonce recall passed after tunnel reopen 2.24 s, client restart 1.10 s and verified server
  restart 2.30 s, and a one-turn `launch-omp` smoke answered `ROUTE OK` with owned stop). The 0.2.10 `kvvram-envpg`,
  0.2.9 `kvvram-envpg`, 0.2.9 batch-MTP base, 0.2.8 batch-MTP, 0.2.8 `slots4-parking`, 0.2.7, 0.2.3, 0.2.1, 0.1.44.1,
  0.1.43.1, 0.1.43 and 0.1.42 262K routes and `client-rtxpro6000-strata0.1.41-omp18.8.6` 131K route stay earlier history.
- Not supported: images, remote clients other than those qualified current and rollback Mac-to-RTX PRO 6000 routes, other
  operating systems, durable engine state across restarts, multiple tenants. Comparisons with other runtimes are
  separate, comparison-only tools.
- Security: loopback only, API key required on every model, control and metrics route, key in a user-only
  file, ambient provider credentials scrubbed from OMP's environment, no telemetry. Not a sandbox, a
  multi-tenant service or an egress firewall.
